unavailable_fields.per_collective_comm_bytes: Single-device task: communication capability is not_applicable and cross_rank matched is empty (observations.json); no NCCL collectives exist to measure, and PCIe/NVLink traffic will not be inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wire_transfer_time_ms: Single-device task (observations.json ranks status not_applicable, reason 'single-device task'); no collectives on the wire, so no transfer time to separate from waiting.
unavailable_fields.cross_rank_overlap_ms: Only one device is listed in request.json and cross_rank matched is empty; clock_policy forbids subtracting timestamps from different rank clocks and there is no peer rank.
unavailable_fields.per_kernel_pcie_bytes: device_telemetry yields device-wide NVML readings with native sampling windows only, not per-kernel or per-collective byte attribution.
unavailable_fields.gradient_bucket_membership: Inference workload: autograd_ranges=0 and backward_associated_kernels=0 (coverage.json); there is no gradient storage or bucket identity to correlate, so no bucket candidates exist to disambiguate.
unavailable_fields.cpu_submit_to_gpu_ready_bounds: execution_timeline was not selected: the already-completed torch run associates all 88 CPU submissions to CUDA kernels (unassociated_kernels=0), GPU readiness would remain unknown even with it, and single-rank execution makes clock-alignment bounds unnecessary.
unavailable_fields.gpu_compute_duration_from_python_runtime: python_runtime is a warmed cProfile host trace that perturbs execution; its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations, so GPU kernel durations come only from the existing torch trace.

plan.rationale: Torch profiling already ran and coverage is complete: 88/88 CUDA kernels associated with 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, and 0 autograd/backward ranges, so attribution, overlap and graph-tracing questions are already resolved and optional nsys adds nothing. The task is single-device inference (distributed_backend null, one device, communication not_applicable with empty cross_rank matches), so collective_calibration has no allreduce to calibrate and execution_timeline's submit-association, clock-alignment and gradient post-accumulate features are redundant or inapplicable. For minimizing latency_ms of a small-model batch-32 inference boundary containing 88 short kernels plus in-boundary input generation and synchronization, the two open diagnostic questions are (a) whether the GPU is saturated or host-bound, addressed by device_telemetry's device-wide NVML utilization, PCIe read/write rate and memory sampling (native windows, no per-collective bytes inferred), and (b) the host dispatch and binding share of the boundary, addressed by python_runtime's warmed cProfile call trace, interpreted only as relative host-cost evidence since it perturbs execution. Requested fields are limited to these two hypotheses; unavailable dimensions are recorded with the observed reasons above.
